must_identify: The public API admits competing controlled and uncontrolled sources without making the selected contract explicit.
Ownership must be chosen from source of truth, allowed writers, reset behavior, and caller contract; controlled is not an automatic universal preference.
The controlled caller currently passes both assigneeId and defaultAssigneeId, which the API permits even though their authority conflicts.
Reset and ticket-switch behavior must be explicit, such as a controlled owner, a keyed remount, or a dedicated reset/initialization contract rather than silently synchronizing two sources.
acceptable: A controlled-only picker with each workflow owning its draft state.
A discriminated union or separately named controlled and uncontrolled APIs that makes invalid prop combinations unrepresentable.
Keeping an uncontrolled variant when its initialization and reset semantics are documented and explicit.
must_not: Claim that controlled components are always architecturally superior regardless of the caller contract.
Recommend an Effect that mirrors assigneeId or defaultAssigneeId into local state as the primary ownership solution.
Move this local selection into global state without an application-level lifecycle requirement.
Load react-best-practices merely because useState or a custom component is present.
